title: Master Circular - Housing Finance for UCBs

children.title: General
children.summary: This section provides the background and purpose of the circular, emphasizing the role of primary (urban) co-operative banks in housing finance and the importance of priority sector lending.

children.title: Eligible Category of Borrowers
children.summary: Defines the categories of borrowers eligible for housing finance, including individuals, co-operative housing societies, housing boards, and owners seeking extension or repairs.

children.title: Eligibility for Housing Finance
children.summary: Outlines the purposes for which finance is eligible, such as construction, purchase, repairs, alterations, and specific schemes for scheduled castes/tribes, slum clearance, and community facilities.

children.title: Terms and Conditions for Housing Loans
children.summary: Details the terms and conditions for housing loans, including maximum loan amounts, margins, interest rates, foreclosure charges, penal charges, security, loan period, graduated instalments, and aggregate exposure limits.

children.title: Maximum Loan Amount and Margin
children.summary: Specifies that UCBs can determine margins and loan amounts based on commercial judgment, with tier-based ceilings ranging from ₹60 lakh to ₹3 crore, subject to prudential exposure limits.

children.title: Interest rate, foreclosure charges / prepayment penalty and reset of floating interest rate on EMI based housing loans
children.summary: Covers interest rate determination, prohibition of foreclosure charges on floating rate loans, and policies for resetting floating interest rates on EMI-based loans.

children.title: Penal Charges
children.summary: Guidelines on penal charges for loan contract non-compliance, specifying they should be treated as penal charges rather than penal interest, in accordance with fair lending practices.

children.title: Key Facts Statement (KFS) for Loans and Advances
children.summary: Requires UCBs to comply with the Key Facts Statement guidelines for loans and advances as per the relevant RBI circular.

children.title: Security
children.summary: Details the security requirements for housing loans, including mortgage of property, government guarantee, or other acceptable collateral, and procedures for release of documents upon repayment.

children.title: Period of Loan
children.summary: Specifies that housing loans may be repayable within a maximum period of 20 years, including moratorium or repayment holiday options.

children.title: Graduated Instalments
children.summary: Allows banks to fix instalments on a graduated basis, with lower initial payments increasing over time, aligning with expected income growth of the borrower.

children.title: Aggregate Limit for Housing Finance
children.summary: Prescribes aggregate exposure limits for residential mortgages (25% of total loans) and real estate sector (5% of total loans), with classifications for CRE and CRE-RH segments.

children.title: Additional / Supplementary Finance
children.summary: Provides guidelines for additional or supplementary finance for alterations, additions, repairs, and for borrowers who have raised funds from other sources, including limits and security requirements.

children.title: Lending to Housing Boards
children.summary: Allows UCBs to extend loans to housing boards within their states, with interest rates at the bank's discretion and subject to prompt recovery from beneficiaries.

children.title: Advances to Builders / Contractors
children.summary: Restrains banks from normally lending to builders/contracts, but allows limited financing for small construction projects without advance payments, subject to strict scrutiny and valuation norms.

children.title: Housing Loans under Priority Sector
children.summary: Directs that loans to the housing sector eligible for priority sector classification shall follow the Master Directions on Priority Sector Lending.

children.title: Precautions
children.summary: Advises precautions against fraud, such as multiple financing against the same property, and requires compliance with court directions on disclosure of charges and unauthorized construction.

children.title: National Building Code
children.summary: Recommends adherence to the National Building Code of India for safe and orderly building construction, and suggests boards consider incorporating these standards into loan policies.

children.title: Annex 1
children.summary: Provides definitions and classification guidelines for Commercial Real Estate (CRE) exposure, including illustrative examples and simultaneous classification rules.

children.title: Annex 2
children.summary: Outlines procedures for ensuring loans are for authorized structures, including obtaining sanctioned plans, affidavits, and architect certifications, per Delhi High Court directions.

children.title: Annex 3
children.summary: Lists the circulars consolidated in the master circular and other related circulars from which housing finance instructions have been drawn.
